component.name: Halo
component.summary: Disk space analyzer and secure file shredder

description.p: Halo shows what is filling your disk as an interactive sunburst, and lets you securely shred what you find — including the thumbnails and recent-file entries your desktop leaves behind.

ul.li: Live sunburst that refines while it scans, with Outline, Biggest and Oldest lists
DoD 5220.22-M 3-pass method or a single random pass, with verification
Removes thumbnails, recent-file entries and copies in the Trash
Honest warnings for SSDs, copy-on-write filesystems, snapshots and sync folders
Works entirely offline: no account, no tracking, no internet

screenshot.caption: The sunburst with the list panel

description.p: Fixes unclickable dialog buttons, press-and-hold, and a clipped menu row.
